title: [VSC-14] VS Code: read-only Accounts view in the Moe sidebar
description:
Epic epic-aabc654d (VS Code works + plugin reuse), sliced by task-a3e414a3 (VSC-0). Depends on VSC-13 (task-065e4812d96247cc8394b3cd0416475d: moe-vscode/src/util/AccountPresentation.ts), which itself depends on VSC-12 (the client's accountRotation and onAccountsChanged) and VSC-7 (the accounts corpus).

Objective: show Claude account rotation in VS Code the way JetBrains' Accounts tab lists it (moe-jetbrains AccountsPanel.kt): one item per AccountPresentation row, the chips line, and an empty or disconnected state, refreshed on onAccountsChanged and on connection changes. Read-only in this row.

Deliverable: new moe-vscode/src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts (a TreeDataProvider modelled on ManagedVmTreeProvider.ts); moe-vscode/package.json gains a "moe.accounts" view in the moe views container and a "moe.accounts.refresh" command with a view/title entry; moe-vscode/src/extension.ts registers both; new moe-vscode/tests/accounts-view.test.cjs drives the provider under node:vm with a fake vscode and a fake client.

Not in scope: add, remove, move, rename, switch-percent and sign-in actions (VSC-15), any MoeDaemonClient.ts change, any moe-jetbrains file.

Verification (GLOBAL rail: never npm in the shared checkout): `git archive HEAD` of the whole repo into a fresh directory outside the checkout, overlay this task's files, then in <snapshot>/moe-vscode run `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test` under `env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin` (mem:gotcha-vscode-gate-from-wsl).
definitionOfDone: moe-vscode/package.json declares the moe.accounts view in the moe views container and the moe.accounts.refresh command with a view/title entry for that view, and tests/accounts-view.test.cjs asserts both from package.json.

With a fake client holding a two-account rotation, the provider's getChildren returns one item per AccountPresentation row, in row order, with labels and descriptions resolved to the MoeBundle English.

Firing onAccountsChanged or onConnectionChanged makes the provider fire onDidChangeTreeData; a disconnected client or a null rotation yields the single empty-state item; dispose() removes every listener it added.
moe-vscode/src/extension.ts registers the provider and the refresh command and pushes both disposables into context.subscriptions.
In a git-archive snapshot of HEAD plus this diff, `cd moe-vscode && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test` exits 0 with 0 failures.
